 Add UI Suggest to Final Mission.

notes.title: We are delighted to announce that the full version of our game is now over 70%
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I’m the developer of The Secret Story!

We are delighted to announce that the full version of our game is now over 70% complete! 

We are currently refining the storyline and integrating various narrative choices to make them more accessible and enjoyable for players who love decision-driven experiences. Despite being a small team with only one primary developer, we are working tirelessly to create a high-quality game. We hope to finish development and release the game ahead of schedule!

Full Version Updates:

 A variety of in-game puzzles for added fun and challenge
 Enhanced animation systems
 Improved UX/UI for a more engaging experience
 More diverse storylines based on different choices
 Expanded levels, increasing from 1 level in the demo to 6 levels in the full version


We have now disabled downloads for the demo version because we are committed to improving the DEMO to make it even more enjoyable. For those who love story-driven games exploring beliefs, mysteries, and unique experiences, feel free to Wishlist The Secret Story now!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The Secret Story First Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I’m the developer of The Secret Story! 

Today, I’d like to share an update on the progress of the game’s development with all of you.

First of all, I’m excited to announce that we’ve uploaded  The Secret Story DEMO  version. It’s currently under review by the platform team and will be available for free as soon as possible.

 You can download The Secret Story DEMO Free Play from our store page here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393910/The_Secret_Story_Demo_Free_Play/?beta=0

 In this free-to-play demo, players will be able to experience: 


A brief overview of our gameplay system
 Basic controls and mechanics
 Using interactive buttons to engage with objects and perform activities
 UX/UI menu adjustments
 A portion of the introductory storyline, which you can fully complete in the DEMO


 If you enjoy story-driven games about beliefs, mysteries, and unusual experiences, we highly recommend downloading the demo to get a feel for the gameplay. 

We apologize that the  DEMO Free to Play version  doesn’t contain extensive content yet.  Please don’t rush to conclusions or judgments!  The full version of the game will include a wealth of additional content and special features that you won’t want to miss.

 Thank you for your support!
